_comment: Tenant-neutral on purpose: no store name, no product vocabulary. A deployment
adds its own template patterns and cut-point words in its own files, named by
the GOLDEN_SEO_PATTERN_FILES setting (same shape as this file); they are merged
onto these defaults, never edited into them.
Every pattern must compile identically in Python `re` and JavaScript RegExp
(no lookbehind, no named groups, no inline flags; `flags` is '' or 'i'), so a
storefront or a form script can mirror the same list.

truncation._comment: CUT OFF (strict, is_cut_off): a title ending in one of `title_bad_endings` or on a `strict_dangling_words` word; a meta whose last word before its closing punctuation is a `strict_dangling_words` word, or that matches a `meta_patterns` entry. POSSIBLY TRUNCATED (soft, is_truncated): cut off, OR a meta with no closing punctuation, OR a last word in `soft_dangling_words`. Words compare case-insensitively.
